text:
maya: heads up — seeing a spike in RDMA connect resets for multi-gpu NCCL jobs in us-west2 pool-g5 after last-night ToR ASIC firmware push
liam: what errors in the logs?
sophia: ibv_rc_pingpong shows `RDMACM: cm_id: failed to establish` and kernel shows `mlx5_core: qp state error -> RST` intermittently
maya: yep, also gpudirect failures with `-EIO` in our userland — flows look fine for a few seconds then time out
kevin: any correlation with MTU or jumbo fallback?
maya: MTU unchanged (9000) but capture shows out-of-order UDP fragments between hosts, p99 reordering spikes ~30-60ms windows
liam: that smells like ECMP hashing differences after firmware changed — vendor notes mentioned "hash rewrite for high scale"
sophia: if ECMP flips flow paths mid-session that causes RoCEv2 packets to be reordered -> RC resets, exactly what we see
ops-oncall: infra-bot just detected deploy and flagged rollback possibility: `deploy/tor-fw/us-west2` :warning:
infra-bot: automated note: 5 hosts in pool-g5 reported 20+ rdma_conn resets in 10m window; alert created #inc-4281
kevin: mitigation ideas: 1) roll firmware back on affected ToRs (impact: manual rollback, risk for other fixes) 2) disable ECMP hashing for UDP 4789/4791 (targeted rule) 3) pin RDMA flows via static routes or policy-based routing
liam: also can try local kernel tuning: increase RQ size, enable reorder-resilience knobs, and disable tso/gso for the RoCE interface as temporary band-aid
sophia: we tested disabling UDP ECMP in a lab switch and saw RDMA reconnects stabilize, but throughput dropped ~6% due to less path utilization
maya: tradeoff noted — for Dedicated customers on these hosts we risk throughput vs reliability. ops: any customer-facing impact yet?
ops-oncall: so far 3 jobs retried automatically, one SLO breach for queueing delay. Support pinged the tenant; they're watching.
kevin: propose plan: schedule immediate targeted firmware rollback on 2 ToRs that host highest NCCL density, while we patch configs to disable UDP ECMP globally on affected pods. Rollback window 22:00 PDT, ops present
liam: +1 but need approval from platform leads. Also prepare playbook: snippet to disable hashing:
```
# on switch mgmt
switch# conf t
  no ip route-hash udp 4789
  no ip route-hash udp 4791
end
```
kevin: and kernel toggle on hosts:
```
ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off
sysctl -w net.core.rps_default_mask=...  # adjust RPS/RFS
```
sophia: we'll run a canary after rollback and throttle NCCL job scheduling to the canary hosts only
maya: I'll open a short PR to mark these hosts as maintenance and throttle scheduling. tagging @kevin @liam for the rollout steps :eyes:
ops-oncall: creating incident timeline and customer comms draft now
liam: thanks team — let's keep thread updates minimal and hit the rollback plan if ops gives green
maya: ack, starting pre-check list now (verify backups, BGP adjacencies, config snapshots).
